evidence.locator: Energy demand from AI → Data centre electricity consumption; 2024 estimate and 2030 Base Case
evidence.excerpt: Electricity consumption from data centres is estimated to amount to around 415 terawatt hours (TWh), or about 1.5% of global electricity consumption in 2024. Global electricity consumption for data centres is projected to double to reach around 945 TWh by 2030 in the Base Case.

evidence.locator: December 20, 2024 release → paragraph beginning “The report indicates”
evidence.excerpt: The report indicates that total data center electricity usage climbed from 58 TWh in 2014 to 176 TWh in 2023 and estimates an increase between 325 to 580 TWh by 2028.

evidence.locator: Chapter 1, section 1.3 Inference Cost, printed page 64 (PDF page 65), figure 1.3.22. 3:1 weighted input/output price; MMLU 64.8 threshold.
evidence.excerpt: Inference cost for an AI model scoring the equivalent of GPT-3.5 (64.8) on MMLU dropped from $20 per million tokens in November 2022 to just $0.07 per million tokens by October 2024. The reported price is a 3:1 weighted average of input and output token prices.
